title: AgentEval: Evidence-Bounded Assessment of Stateful Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Task completion alone does not determine whether a stateful agent satisfied its obligations, and a recorded judgment does not guarantee that its supporting evidence remains valid. We present AgentEval, a system that carries a contract-bound assessment record through tool execution, state and event capture, report qualification, and case maintenance. It separates what the agent did, what the evidence establishes, and whether the conclusion is supported for present use. On 32 tool-world administrations, independent checks agree on all 30 complete episodes, distinguishing satisfied, violated, and unresolved obligations; two interrupted administrations are retained. Controlled interventions on 48 evidence views expose 36 binding faults missed by hash-only checks without changing agent behavior. translated_title: AgentEval：有状态智能体的证据有界评估
translated_abstract: 仅凭任务完成并不能确定一个有状态智能体是否履行了其义务，而已记录的判断也不能保证其支撑证据仍然有效。我们提出了AgentEval，一个在工具执行、状态与事件捕获、报告资格审查以及案例维护全过程中携带契约绑定评估记录的系统。它将“智能体做了什么”、“证据确立了什么”以及“结论在当前使用中是否得到支持”这三个问题区分开来。在32次工具世界运行中，独立核查对全部30个完整片段达成一致，能够区分已履行、已违反和未解决的义务；两次中断的运行被保留。对48个证据视图的受控干预暴露出36个仅靠哈希校验会遗漏的绑定故障，且不改变智能体的行为。Scenario Studio将经过审查的案例与12份两轮报告（含24个经独立核查的答案）关联起来。另一项针对192个保留样本的公开基准研究……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: AgentEval提出了一种契约绑定的证据有界评估框架，将有状态智能体的行为记录、证据有效性验证与结论支持性判断三者分离，能在工具执行和案例维护全过程中持续追踪证据是否仍然有效，从而发现仅靠哈希校验会遗漏的绑定故障。
en_tdlr: AgentEval introduces a contract-bound, evidence-bounded assessment framework that separates what a stateful agent did from what its evidence establishes and whether conclusions remain valid for present use, exposing binding evidence faults that hash-only checks miss.
